name: Ronova
desc: The Ruler of Death, one of the Heavenly Principles' Shades.

customize.text:

".. Anyway. It's time I put this space out of its misery."

customize.name: Heavenly Principles
customize.desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.name: Shades
customize.desc: Four Shades created by the Primordial One.

customize.text:
Ronova is one of the four Shades.
Curse of Death
When a nation achieves a certain level of technological advancement to counter the Heavenly Principles, Ronova temporarily "kills" everyone in the area where the idea that could lead to the plan's success originated. The deceased are revived after a period of time, with no memory of the events or their thoughts.
Curse of Immortality
During the

customize.name: Khaenri'ahn cataclysm
customize.desc: A disaster that occurred 500 years ago. The Abyss was released into Teyvat and Khaenri'ah was destroyed.

customize.text: , Ronova cursed the pureblood people of
with immortality. Their souls are unable to merge with the Ley Lines, and their bodies slowly decompose under the influence of erosion.

customize.name: Fatui
customize.desc: A Snezhnayan organization that is loyal to the Tsaritsa and has spread out all over the continent. Its Harbingers are on the hunt for the Gnoses.

customize.text: The Fatui intend to get rid of Ronova, as her Curse of Death is preventing them from succeeding in Project Mistilteinn, which involves opposing the Heavenly Principles.

customize.name: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night
customize.desc: An angel who created the Night Kingdom in Natlan.

customize.text: Under Ronova's guidance, the Lord of the Night created the Night Kingdom in Natlan.

customize.name: Xbalanque
customize.desc: The first Pyro Archon, who defeated the Flamelord and revived from the flames.

customize.text: Ronova gave powers to the first Pyro Archon. With it, the rules of Natlan were established: the Ode of Resurrection and the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame.

customize.name: Mavuika
customize.desc: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

customize.text: The last Pyro Archon used the power of the divine throne and Ronova's power to fight with the Abyss. The price for the Ruler of Death's power is death.

customize.name: Il Capitano
customize.desc: The First of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and the Sentinel Knight of Khaenri'ah. His real name is Thrain.

customize.text: The Ruler of Death cast a curse of immortality on the Khaenri'ahns, including the Sentinel Knight. The Captain sacrificed himself instead of Mavuika for using Ronova's powers. He wanted to use the shade's rules against her. To sustain the curse of immortality, the Ruler of Death relinquishes her demand for the price of "death."

customize.name: Paimon
customize.desc: The Traveler's best friend and Teyvat guide.

customize.text: A creation of Celestia, who doesn't possess any of Celestia's power or authority. The Ruler of Death wanted to take Paimon with her, but the Traveler and Pierro stopped her. Afterward, the Traveler teamed up with the Fatui to eliminate Ronova and protect Paimon.
